chunks.title: Research – Avantgarde HIDPS
chunks.content: During his undergraduate studies at BRAC University, Naser Al Noman worked on research titled “Avantgarde: A Machine Learning Based Hybrid Host-Based Intrusion Detection and Prevention System.” The paper is currently under review. Avantgarde is a HIDPS framework that counters cyber threats by leveraging AI, automation, zero-trust architecture, and open-source tools for enhanced threat detection, prevention, and response. The work discusses the impacts and constraints of the chosen technologies, explains the Avantgarde design process, and evaluates the framework on the BCCC-CIC-IDS2017 dataset and live network data. Performance analysis indicates improved threat-detection accuracy, access control, fewer false positives, and greater network resilience. Abstract: In the age of the Internet, cyber threats are increasing at an exponential rate, targeting individuals and institutions of all types. The need for a proper cybersecurity infrastructure integrated with the latest innovations such as artificial intelligence, zero-trust architecture, and automation has become paramount, especially when malicious actors use AI to their advantage. This paper presents a HIDPS framework called Avantgarde to counter cyber threats by leveraging AI, automation, zero-trust architecture, and open-source tools to create integrated systems with enhanced threat detection, prevention, and response capabilities. The research assesses the effectiveness of this approach and its potential to meet online security requirements. It discusses the impacts and constraints of the chosen technologies, reviews the Avantgarde design process, and evaluates Avantgarde on the BCCC-CIC-IDS2017 dataset and live network data. Analysis on performance indicators shows that Avantgarde’s framework improves overall threat-detection accuracy, access control, reduction of false positives, and network resilience, highlighting its potential as an adaptive framework capable of addressing modern security challenges in an ever-evolving digital landscape.

chunks.title: Personal & Academic Projects
chunks.content: 1. Enterprise Playwright Automation Platform (React, Vite, TypeScript, Tailwind, React Query, Recharts, Node.js, Express, Prisma, JWT, NeonDB/PostgreSQL, Playwright, Allure, Vercel, Render, GitHub Actions): Full-stack QA automation platform to trigger Playwright suites from a dashboard, stream live results via SSE, browse run history and analytics, attach Allure reports, and ingest CI runs from GitHub Actions. Features JWT auth with RBAC (ADMIN vs MEMBER), test suite/case management, multi-browser execution (Chromium/Firefox/WebKit), failure screenshots and traces, and analytics for pass rate, flaky tests, duration, and browser breakdown. GitHub: https://github.com/Naser-Al-Noman/Enterprise-Playwright-Automation-Platform. Live demo: https://enterprise-playwright-automation-pl.vercel.app. Backend health: https://enterprise-playwright-automation-platform.onrender.com/api/health. 2. API Automation Platform (React, Node.js, Express, PostgreSQL, Newman, Postman): Full-stack platform for automating REST API tests with Postman collections and Newman. Upload collections and environments, run tests from the UI or CI, validate responses with JSON Schema, review HTML reports, and monitor pass-rate and performance trends. GitHub: https://github.com/Naser-Al-Noman/API-Automation-Platform. Live demo: https://api-automation-platform-weld.vercel.app/. 3. AI Test Case Generator (Python, Streamlit, Google Gemini, Pandas): Streamlit app that turns software requirements and user stories into structured test cases using the Google Gemini API. Review results in a table and export them as CSV or Excel. GitHub: https://github.com/Naser-Al-Noman/Ai-Test-Case-Generator. Live demo: https://ai-test-case-generator1.streamlit.app/. 4. QA Analytics Dashboard (Python, Streamlit, Pandas, Plotly): Data-source agnostic QA analytics dashboard for test execution and defect metrics. Upload CSV, JSON, or Excel results to explore KPIs, flaky tests, severity trends, and failure-to-defect correlation charts. GitHub: https://github.com/Naser-Al-Noman/qa-dashboard. Live demo: https://dashboardfortest.streamlit.app/. 5. Blood Donation Services (Python, Flask, SQLite, Cryptography): Flask platform for blood donation requests, donor discovery by blood group and area, and donation campaigns. Sensitive data is encrypted at rest with hashed passwords and integrity checks. GitHub: https://github.com/Naser-Al-Noman/bloodservices. Live demo: https://bloodaid-2wfk.onrender.com/.
